left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Among the pregnant women  [AND] who were administered cesarean section in this study, those who agreed to participate in this study

Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Fetal distress requiring fast delivery

right.raw_text: -  Patients with hypersensitivity, allergic response, [OR]  resistance to the drugs used in this study (fentanyl, [OR]  ropivacaine, [OR]  lidocaine)

left.raw_text:
-  Patients who is not possible for regional anesthesia
  -  Patients who refused to participate in this study
-  Patients who cannot read or understand the agreement

right.raw_text: -  Patients whose weight is less than 50kg  [OR] or exceeds 100kg
